status: published_training_recipe; technical validation passed, no final performance acceptance claim
reference_recipe: elf3_dwaq_still_pose_v1; the recipe used to continue still100000 to102500
initialization: user explicitly chose from_scratch; do not load102500 or any optimizer

reward_changes_from_reference_recipe.formula: sum absolute actual joint position minus asset default position using identical named native indices
reward_changes_from_reference_recipe.activation: finite max(abs(vx,vy,wz)) <= 1e-6, immediate; no settled/contact/timer/terrain gate
reward_changes_from_reference_recipe.meaning: soft actual-state costs; no hard joint targets, clamps, action filters or world-height term

preserved.strict_zero_motion_cost: original mean absolute raw dq, weight -0.5; not strengthened
preserved.phase: original still current/all-history fixed [0,0,1,-1] at zero; no v3 phase substitution
preserved.zero_periodic_rewards: original still gates contact/swing rewards off
preserved.joint_speed_feedback: original lpf20 observation path; physical actuator PD unchanged
preserved.deployment: 500 input /29 output; original still preprocessing embedded in exports

validation.cpu_suite: 367 tests,one intentionally skipped; full regression passed before formal launch
validation.native_smoke: 64 envs x20 updates completed successfully from scratch; model19 is technical-only and is NOT imported into formal training
validation.native_wiring: 20 envs x600 steps; strict zero/moving transitions,4leg+3waist native indices,L1 formula,raw-history/critic/clock preservation and original gait gates passed
validation.behavioral_acceptance: not established by technical smoke; no promise of exact stillness,default pose,or unchanged obstacle success before trained evaluation

reproduction.environment: Python3.10 / IsaacSim4.5.0 / IsaacLab v2.1.1; see requirements-elf3.txt and scripts/setup_elf3_env.sh
reproduction.train: LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 bash elf3.sh scripts/train_elf3_still_v2.py --num-envs 16384 --iterations 100001 --seed 42 --run-name still_v2_scratch_16384_seed42 --swanlab-project DWAQ --headless --device cuda:0
reproduction.swanlab: Run bash elf3.sh -m swanlab login on the other host; credentials are local, never committed. Each host creates its own run and local log directory.
reproduction.optional_visual_cache: Default launch does NOT use --use-cached-visual. For an existing verified arrow_x.usd cache only, set ELF3_ARROW_CACHE=/absolute/path/arrow_x.usd and add --use-cached-visual. SHA256 is checked; robot assets and physics are not modified.
reproduction.resource_note: 16384 environments used about18.3GiB GPU memory on the reference24GiB RTX4090. Other machines/drivers may differ; do not silently reduce the count when comparing this recipe.
reproduction.reproducibility_note: Same recipe and seed are recorded; GPU/PhysX floating-point ordering and different hardware do not guarantee identical trajectories or metrics.
